name: log_husbandry
description: Interprets natural-language husbandry notes (e.g. "fed Bob a large mouse and cleaned his water") into Care Events logged in Husbandry Tracker.
how_it_works: This is a Skill, not a device integration: it has no hardware to find. Activating it copies a Claude Code skill into this install's own .claude/skills/log_husbandry/ folder — nothing is written anywhere until you do. Then, in a Claude Code session opened in this install's folder, you can describe care in plain language and Claude turns it into Feeding, Watering, Spot-clean, or Deep-clean Care Events, using a snapshot of your Rooms, Enclosures, and Animals to match names. Husbandry Tracker re-checks every event when it arrives, and holds back any that no longer match instead of guessing.
can: Turn one sentence into several Care Events (e.g. a Feeding and a Watering).
Match Enclosures and Animals by the names you already use.
Fill in Feeding details from the last Feeding when you leave them out.
cannot: Run without Claude Code — it does nothing on its own.
Log anything other than Feeding, Watering, Spot-clean, or Deep-clean.
Create, rename, or delete Enclosures or Animals.
